characters.name: The Fallen
characters.summary: Murdered and bound by a supernatural resurrection pact.

characters.name: The Butcher
characters.summary: A frightening enforcer who secretly left an escape route open on the night of the murder.
characters.hidden_motive: He once helped the protagonist's friend try to get the protagonist out alive. He still chooses to spare the player once in combat.

characters.name: The Strategist
characters.summary: A manipulative tactician who tells partial truths and alters the contract's copy.
characters.hidden_motive: He tests whether the protagonist will choose violence when an escape route remains open.

characters.name: The Betrayer
characters.summary: Your closest friend. He did fire the fatal shot, but the reason and the memory around it are incomplete.
characters.hidden_motive: He tried the Butcher's escape route, then shot the protagonist to interrupt a binding ritual that would have permanently surrendered the protagonist's soul.
